source: The author’s one-page unit procedure for family meetings, version 2.0, November 2026. It is not in this repository: it names the unit, its institution and the products it uses.

differs.basis: The site’s own statement of where the workflow comes from. It stands in for the procedure’s title lines, which name the unit, its institution and its owner.
differs.steps.book.action: Changed on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17: the calendar is the meeting lead’s. The procedure names the psychiatrist.
differs.steps.bring-up.action: Changed on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17: the meeting lead is told the family has arrived. The procedure names the psychiatrist.
differs.steps.meet.ownerLabel: Changed on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17: an APP or a resident may lead. The procedure names the psychiatrist.
differs.steps.note.ownerLabel: Changed on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17: an APP or a resident may lead and sign. The procedure names the psychiatrist.
differs.steps.bridge.ownerLabel: Changed on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17: an APP or a resident may lead. The procedure names the psychiatrist.
differs.formats.menu.0.name: Expanded from the procedure’s short form, “5-min phone update”. Step 3 keeps the short forms.
differs.formats.menu.1.name: Expanded from the procedure’s short form, “30-min structured”.
differs.formats.menu.2.name: Expanded from the procedure’s short form, “60–90-min alliance repair (optional)”.
differs.measures.cadence: Recast as a sentence. The procedure has it in brackets after its heading: “(monthly, from the chart and the calendar)”.
differs.measures.list.2.name: Given a capital letter. The procedure lists the measures in one line, and this one begins in lower case.
differs.additions.sleep-figure.text: Added. Listed under “additions” with its basis.
differs.additions.no-results.text: Added. Listed under “additions” with its basis.
differs.additions.resident-supervision.text: Added on the author’s instruction, 2026-11-17. Listed under “additions” with its basis.
